explication: Atlassian MCP Server is a remote MCP integration package, not the cloud server implementation itself. The principal workflow is: an AI client loads a client configuration and optional skills, authenticates, invokes the hosted MCP endpoint, and receives real-time Atlassian data or mutations. The README documents search/summarization, Loom review, work-item/page creation and updates, and automation workflows. The repository also contains validation code, but that is packaging infrastructure and is intentionally omitted from this runtime-oriented map.
